verdict.rationale: Bevy is a free, open-source Rust game engine used as a normal crate dependency. It has no hosted service, accounts, or API surface that issues credentials, so scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Bevy shipping any credential-issuance capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
